summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group announcing the filing of its Form 20-F annual report for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, with SEC and website availability. This is a routine disclosure of audited financial statements under U.S. GAAP, not a special situation. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural terms are present. The registrant acts solely as the foreign issuer fulfilling reporting obligations. What to watch: N/A — purely administrative.
